integrity: The claims are derived explicitly from the cited free propagator and independent stationary renewal age. Algebraic and numerical checks supplement, but do not replace, the proof. No independent scientific review has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: One-point stationary continuum Itô law only; symmetric nonsticky extension at the origin is assumed.
Independent complete Poisson resetting to zero with a known unit diffusion prefactor; inference does not address finite measurement noise.
Stationary Bessel density, free propagator and qualitative bimodality are prior results.
title: A log-product fluctuation law and sharp kurtosis calibration for strongly sluggish resetting diffusion
